Web Scraper / Data Extraction Specialist
Client Name: CrowdPlat (Internal Role)
Job Description (click to expand / collapse)
dropdown
Location: Remote, Canada Duration: Task-based, on-demand (no guaranteed minimum hours) Hours: Variable, per project need

Overview

This is a task-based freelance opportunity supporting outreach and research operations. The role focuses on locating and extracting structured contact data from public web sources and delivering clean, ready-to-use datasets quickly. This is not an ongoing development role — the emphasis is on accurate data delivery, not code ownership.

Key Responsibilities

Extract contact details (names, emails, job titles, institutions) from academic directories, university pages, and professional websites
Deliver clean, structured output in CSV or Excel format ready to use with no cleanup required
Work on specific data requests as assigned on a task-by-task basis
Handle pagination and multiple source formats accurately
Ensure all extracted and delivered data outputs are formatted in compliance with Section 508 accessibility standards where applicable
Turn around requests quickly with minimal back and forth
Required Qualifications

Proven experience extracting data from public web sources accurately and at speed
Proficiency in Python (BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, Selenium, or Playwright) or equivalent tools
Ability to work with APIs and JSON data where available
Familiarity with Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards
Strong attention to detail with critical focus on data quality
Reliable turnaround on short timelines with clear communication
Preferred Qualifications

Experience scraping academic or government directories
Familiarity with LinkedIn, university faculty pages, and research profile databases
Ability to handle anti-bot measures and rate limiting responsibly
Work Location & Requirements

Fully remote position
Based in Canada
Task-based on-demand role with no guaranteed minimum hours per week
Required / Preferred Skills
Required: Proven experience extracting data from public web sources accurately and at speed (2+ yrs), Proficiency in Python (BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, Selenium, or Playwright) or equivalent tools Required (2+ yrs), Ability to work with APIs and JSON data where available (2+ yrs), Familiarity with Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards (2+ yrs), Strong attention to detail with critical focus on data quality (2+ yrs), Reliable turnaround on short timelines with clear communication (2+ yrs)

Preferred: Experience scraping academic or government directories (2+ yrs), Familiarity with LinkedIn, university faculty pages, and research profile databases (2+ yrs), Ability to handle anti-bot measures and rate limiting responsibly (2+ yrs)
